plugins.name: client-360
plugins.description: Customer 360 relationship cockpit — a worklist-first React artifact plus a natural-chat layer over the Salesforce-hosted Customer360 MCP data plane (24 tools: 9 reads plus 7 governed stage/execute write pairs and one stage-only renewal, per-user OAuth). Needs-action queue, activity audit trail, covenant effective-challenge, page-agnostic AI chat, data-gated Client Actions, and guided workflows for client-request-to-action, package-scoped covenant review, collateral valuation and relationship actions. Every write stages first, shows the org's warnings verbatim, and executes only on a named human's confirmation.
